_comment: Frozen test vectors for Quicksend's HKDF/AES-256-GCM/HMAC scheme (see docs/DECISIONS.md and docs/PROTOCOL.md). Both server/internal/cryptoutil (Go) and web/crypto.js (Web Crypto) are tested against this file so the two independent implementations are proven to agree byte-for-byte, not just individually self-consistent.

chunkVectors.name: empty final chunk (exact multiple of chunk size)

metadataVector._comment: File metadata is encrypted with EncryptChunk under the reserved MetadataChunkIndex (2^64-1) sentinel, last=true. chunkIndex isn't listed here as a JSON number since 2^64-1 can't round-trip through JS's Number type — both implementations hardcode the sentinel instead of parsing it from JSON.
